status: immutable record - reruns must write a new file, never overwrite this

held_constant.hyperparameter_search: TimeSeriesSplit, 5 folds, inside the training window
held_constant.evaluation: out of sample, one refit per session per ticker

known_limits: The research feature sets are not the production config; 'production' here is a close mirror missing us_2y_yield, us_10y_minus_2y_spread, baltic_capesize_index, baltic_panamax_index, iron_ore and us_shipping_equity_proxy, none of which has free daily history.
The production mirror comparison did not run: Yahoo rate limiting blocked the last five symbols.
BUY counts are reported and never used to judge; the threshold was tuned for absolute-return predictions and is not neutral across arms.
Trade statistics in these runs predate the strategy-metrics module, so only counts are recorded here.

multiple_testing.note: Arm-level IC significance against zero is a different question from a paired improvement, and is reported separately.

findings.evidence: divergence +0.041pp (p=6.3e-05) on baseline and +0.049pp (p=9.2e-04) on extended; direction -4.76pp (p=6.4e-04) on baseline, which clears the ~3.1pp this window resolves
rank IC +0.1073, p=0.001, 63 days; clears the Bonferroni threshold
rank IC +0.1130, p=0.001, 63 days; clears the Bonferroni threshold

findings.claim: focused matches extended on ranking at a third the size
findings.evidence: IC gain over baseline +0.048 (p=0.033) vs +0.054 (p=0.075); focused costs nothing in divergence (p=0.94) while extended is significantly worse (p=0.0019)
dropping 18 of them moved 14 of 1,386 predictions and was slightly better on all three metrics; none of the differences is significant
all three metrics fail the pre-registered p<0.017; the IC difference of -0.0080 is far inside the 0.0354 this window resolves

findings.claim: MAE and rank IC disagree about which set is better
findings.evidence: extended has the worst divergence and the best ordering; judging on divergence alone would discard both sets that order the cross-section
